description:
Use this when the user asks for moving averages, RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands, beta or circuit-limit data for an Indian stock.

Returns the latest values of the moving averages, RSI (14), MACD (12, 26, 9), Bollinger Bands (20, 2) and beta against the Nifty 50, with the stock's circuit-filter band and the days it closed at that band. Latest values only: no history of an indicator and no signals. An indicator without enough history is empty and named in `insufficient_history`.

query.description: One company: NSE symbol, ISIN or BSE code, e.g. TCS, INE467B01029 or 532540. Always send it as `query` (not `symbol`).
query.title: Query
